newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish penion funds up 12.3 pct in Q2-survey.
newsitem.headline: Irish penion funds up 12.3 pct in Q2-survey.

text.p: Irish pension funds increased in value by 12.3 percent over the quarter ended June 30 to stand 19.8 percent over their value at the beginning of 1997, a survey be actuaries and benefit consultants Mercer Limited showed on Friday.

Of the 16 investment managers surveyed, Montgomery Govett was the top performer over the second quarter with a return of 14.7 percent followed by Equitable Life's return of 14.3 percent and Eagle Star with a return of 13.4 percent.
Over a five-year period, Standard Life produced the highest return of 18.1 percent followed by Friends Provident with 18 percent and Canada Life with a return of 17.5 percent.
